summary.text: Sally Kerans is a Democratic state representative from the 13th Essex District who has held the seat since January 6, 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sally Kerans graduated from Danvers High School in 1978, earned a B.A. from the University of Massachusetts at Amherst in 1982 and an M.P.A. from Harvard University, and has volunteered with the Danvers Historical Society and the Danvers Finance Committee.
She succeeded Theodore Speliotis in the 13th Essex District seat in 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session she is vice chair of the Public Health Joint Committee and also serves on House Ways and Means, the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee and the Financial Services Joint Committee.
